description:
### v1.43.2

**Firefox**

- Restore Old 3-Dot Menu
- Extension Pinning
- Remember Tab Scroll Position
- Updated Mod Settings Icon and UI
- Support for Newer Firefox Nightly Builds

**MX Player**

- Smart Enhance Control
- Smart Enhance Always On
- Replace Codec to Fix EAC3 Playback
- Recycle Bin Fix
- Configurable MX Player Mod Settings
- Various patch updates and fixes

**All Video Downloader**

- Updated support for v1.9.8
- Additional patches
- Promo item removal updates

**Video Downloader**

- Custom Host Patch
- Custom Popup Blocker
- Updated existing patches and compatibility


**General / Core**

- Density Patch improvements
- Fixed Analytics Removal breaking FCM push notifications
